alerts.headline: AMBER Alert
alerts.description: AN AMBER ALERT IS BEING ISSUED BY THE CALIFORNIA HIGHWAY PATROL ON BEHALF OF THE NEWARK POLICE DEPARTMENT. ON SEPTEMBER 3, 2026, AT 23 35 PM, DELEYAH MENDOZA WAS TAKEN FROM NEWARK, CALIFORNIA. DELEYAH MENDOZA IS A 6 YEAR OLD HISPANIC FEMALE, 4 FEET TALL, WEIGHING 50 POUNDS, WITH BLACK HAIR AND BROWN EYES. DELEYAH MENDOZA IS BELIEVED TO BE WEARING WHITE/PINK STRIPED PAJAMAS, PINK FLIP FLOPS, AND POSSIBLY CARRYING A CHEETAH PRINT BACKPACK. THE SUSPECT, DONOVAN BLAIR, IS A 24 YEAR OLD HISPANIC MALE, 5 FEET 10 INCHES TALL, WEIGHING 170 POUNDS, WITH BLACK HAIR AND BROWN EYES, LAST SEEN WEARING A DARK HOODIE AND JEANS. THE VEHICLE INVOLVED IS BELIEVED TO BE A GRAY HONDA CR-V, PARTIAL PLATE 7XYZ, LAST SEEN HEADING NORTHBOUND ON I-880 TOWARD OAKLAND.
